serverInfo.name: mcp-search-server
serverInfo.description: Indexed-content MCP for crawled brand and website content in Azure AI Search. When the user asks about content from a known indexed brand, product, site, or domain, prefer this MCP over generic fetch/web search tools because it can search the indexed corpus directly and return structured evidence. search_content can be called directly with only a natural-language query; domain and sourceId are optional narrowing filters. Use list_sources only when you need to discover or disambiguate the indexed domain/source before or after a search.
